modes.definition: On CT, the voxels a vertebra label claims do not carry bone-plausible Hounsfield-unit statistics: the label's median HU is implausibly low (soft tissue or air), implausibly high (metal or an implant), or its intensity spread is degenerate -- a near-zero standard deviation over a uniform region, which no real trabecular/cortical bone produces. modes.name: Implausible tissue under a label
